entries.outcome: The archival typed baptism records Marguerite’s birth and baptism on 20 October 1831, naming Benjamin Gendron, cultivateur du lieu, and Marguerite Bourbonnais as parents, with sponsors Antoine Bourbonnais and Marie Gendron. entries.action: 22 November 2026: Reconciled the four public result pages, containing 25 + 25 + 25 + 5 documents, against the completed visual reviews of Documents 1–80.
entries.outcome: All eighty numbered scans were visually inspected without finding Paul or the identified surname variants. The count includes covers, reverse sides and repeated orders, not eighty independent Paul files. Some unrelated faint handwriting remains uncertain. Together with the earlier twelve-scan Folder 7 review, two identified folders are complete. The descriptive-roll indexes, original personal service file, prisoner file and pension records remain separate targets; T288/T289 were not directly searched. C042’s identity as the 1844 groom or the soldier is still unproved; Needs work unchanged.

entries.name: Pierre GENDRON
entries.action: Located the dated original-minutes section for the already-indexed 9 May 1831 inventory
entries.outcome: The catalogue identifies 13 April 1829–28 February 1835, reference 06M,CN602,S16enfACTES7. The Pierre Gendron / deceased Marie-Louise Daniel inventory date falls within this section. The inventory, minute number, heirs, children and tutorship remain unread; no later record or survival of C183 is established. Needs work retained.

entries.name: Francois Regis GENDRON
entries.action: Read all 27 original images, printed pages 56–82
entries.outcome: The section catalogued 1862–1875 actually runs from 4 February 1862, no. 789, through 31 March 1876, no. 1124. No entry naming Régis/François Régis Gendron, Claire Chatigny, or an identifiable estate of Jean Baptiste Gendron and Claire Chatigny was found. Other Gendron entries remain unassigned. This negative result covers only this repertory section; the underlying minutes and the 1876–1879 section remain unread. Likely eliminated retained.

entries.name: Francois Napoleon GENDREAU
entries.source: Le Courrier du Canada, 10 May 1881, p. 2, col. 6; https://numerique.banq.qc.ca/patrimoine/details/52327/2537439
entries.action: Read original issue masthead and Mountain Hill House arrivals
entries.outcome: The notice lists A. Grant, Anguin, followed by Nap. Gendreau, do. Anguin is retained as printed. This supports an adult-record comparison with the 1881 Napoléon Gendrow–Alexander Grant household, but supplies no age, parents, occupation or explicit employment relationship. No link to C243’s 1828 baptism is proved.

entries.name: Francois Napoleon GENDREAU
entries.action: Read original issue masthead and Hotel Dion arrivals; compare the 10 May notice
entries.outcome: The notice lists A Grant, N Gendreau, Amqui. Amqui is explicit. Several neighboring guests also occur in the 10 May Courrier notice, so the two notices are not counted as independent journeys. The hotel headings differ; their relationship remains unestablished. The adult association is compatible with the existing census lead, but an explicit link to Augustin Gendreau and Julie Gagné remains needed. Likely eliminated retained.
